dataset_name: SIH26091 Government Credit, Subsidy and Enterprise Support Schemes
scope: Major central-government credit-linked, subsidy-linked and enterprise-support schemes relevant to rural micro-entrepreneurs, small businesses, artisans, agriculture/allied activities, street vendors, food processing and eligible startups.
coverage_note: This is a curated national dataset, not an exhaustive catalogue of every central or state government scheme in India. Only facts explicitly supported by official government sources are encoded; lender-determined values are left unspecified.

primary_catalog_source.name: JanSamarth Portal / Department of Financial Services
primary_catalog_source.note: Department of Financial Services states that JanSamarth provides access to credit-linked central government schemes and integrates government/lender data sources.

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
schemes.implementing_agency: KVIC, KVIBs, District Industries Centres and banks
schemes.category: Credit-linked margin money subsidy / new micro enterprise

eligibility.education_requirement: At least VIII standard for projects above ₹10 lakh in manufacturing or above ₹5 lakh in business/service.
eligibility.existing_unit_rule: Existing units that have already received specified government assistance are not eligible under the new-unit requirement.

loan.interest_rate_note: Actual lending rate and sanction are determined by the financing bank under applicable PMEGP rules.
loan.repayment: As sanctioned by the financing bank under applicable PMEGP rules.

application_steps: Submit application through the official PMEGP system
Complete required entrepreneurship development training where applicable
Margin money subsidy processing subject to applicable rules

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services
schemes.implementing_agency: Member Lending Institutions

eligibility.purpose: Term loan and working capital for eligible micro enterprises and allied activities.

loan_categories.special_condition: For entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid previous Tarun-category loans, subject to applicable rules.

loan.interest_rate_note: Interest rate is determined by the lending institution under applicable lending policies.
loan.repayment: As sanctioned by the lending institution.

subsidy.note: No fixed subsidy rate is encoded here.

application_steps: Identify an eligible Member Lending Institution
Loan sanction and disbursement subject to lender decision
